source.description: Contoh Desain Rumah Minimalis Modern Terbaru

prompt.zh: 将此客厅重新设计为温馨的日式极简风格。保留原有的空间结构、窗户位置、视角及地面边界。将现有的茶几替换为一张低矮的椭圆形橡木茶几；在沙发左侧放置一盏落地灯；在右侧窗户旁增添一株小型绿植。选用天然橡木、亚麻布艺及暖米白色调。确保物体比例真实、阴影效果统一，并留出通畅的动线空间。请勿添加其他家具。
prompt.en: Redesign this living room in a warm Japanese minimalist style. Keep the original room geometry, window positions, camera perspective and floor boundaries. Replace the existing coffee table with a low oval oak table, place a single floor lamp to the left of the sofa, and add a small green plant near the right window. Use natural oak, linen and warm off-white materials. Ensure realistic object scale, consistent shadows and unobstructed walking space. Do not add extra furniture.
